mechanism: Both cenobamate and alcohol are CNS depressants that additively suppress central nervous system function, and alcohol may inhibit cenobamate metabolism via CYP3A4/CYP2C19, increasing serum levels.
action: Advise patients to avoid or minimize alcohol consumption while taking cenobamate due to increased risk of sedation, dizziness, impaired cognition, and potential loss of seizure control.
